content: Hello, this is Mark from Amazon Refund Department. I noticed something unusual with your recent order and wanted to assist you personally.
Oh, okay. What is the problem? Is my package coming?
I see there is a delay due to a flag on your account regarding unpaid customs fees. I want to reassure you, we are here to help resolve this quickly.
Unpaid customs? I never pay before. What I need do?
No worries, this sometimes happens due to new regulations. To proceed, I just need to confirm your full name and the best phone number for verification. Could you provide those?
Yes, my name is Lin Tao. My phone is 347-555-9821.
Thank you, Lin. Let me check the system... Okay, I see the customs fee pending is $120. Once this is cleared, your package and refund will process immediately.
I not understand. Why I pay now? Can you take from order?
That's a great question. Unfortunately, the customs office requires a separate payment for regulatory reasons. Amazon will fully reimburse you after payment. I can guide you step by step.
You sure? I trust Amazon. But I never do this before. Is safe?
Absolutely, Lin. Many customers must do this now. If you follow my instructions, your information remains private and your money is protected.
Okay. What I need to do?
First, do you have access to Amazon gift cards or can you purchase one at a nearby store? This is the simplest way to handle the customs fee, and we'll guide your refund right after.
I can try. How much card I buy? Just $120?
Yes, a single card of $120 is perfect. If that's not available, you can get two cards of $60 each. Save the receipts and codes for me, please.
I buy card and give you code?
Correct. Once you have the cards, you will scratch the back to reveal the codes. I will enter them into our secure Amazon portal to verify and release your package.
Why I give code? Why not pay on Amazon site?
Customs fees are processed separately from regular orders due to government policy. That's why we're handling this directly, Lin. I promise your refund will be issued right after.
Okay. I go buy now. What I do after?
Once you return, please click this secure Amazon support link I send you. It will open our portal where you can enter the codes safely. Let me know when you're ready.
You send me link now?
Yes, here is the link: https://amazon-support-center.com/refund. Please click it when you have your cards. I will stay on the line to help.
Okay, I see link. I come back in 20 minute and click.
Perfect, Lin. I'll be here. When you're ready, click the link and let me know. We'll finish the process together.
Thank you for helping. I buy card now.
You're welcome. It's my job to make this easy for you. See you soon, Lin.
